_bundle: Novel writing & editing at a high level — continuity, story bible, track-changes, read-back, research.
_setup: Graphiti + Exa are already in the core .mcp.json. The rest are added here. See NOVELS.md for the workflow and per-tool setup (Neo4j for Graphiti, the Obsidian Local REST API plugin, API keys).

graphiti._note: Continuity engine — temporal knowledge graph (who knows what WHEN, timeline, relationships). Also in core. Needs a running Neo4j (docker run neo4j).

obsidian._note: Read/write your story bible & world wiki. Requires the Obsidian 'Local REST API' community plugin enabled in your vault.

adeu._note: DOCX redlining as native Word tracked changes — the editor's workflow. Verify the exact Smithery package id before relying on it.

elevenlabs._note: Read prose aloud (hear rhythm/clunk the eye misses) + audiobook prototyping. Official.

markitdown._note: Convert DOCX / Scrivener exports / PDF <-> clean markdown so AI edits the real file, then back. Microsoft.

exa._note: Research at depth (historical accuracy, comps, fact-checking). Also in core.

google-workspace._note: Optional — if a manuscript lives in Google Docs/Drive (co-editing with agents/editors). Community; OAuth.
